name: pumi-agents
description: Coding agents in pumi's tabs: Claude Code, Codex, pi and more open from the + menu in their own terminal, with a chat over it, or as a chat tab over ACP or their SDK. Their hooks report each one's state, and each one is told about the workspace around it.

images.alt: A Claude Code session as a chat: messages, a tool call, a permission card and the prompt

modes.label: Modes
modes.desc: How each agent opens, by its id: `off`, `terminal`, `chat` (the terminal with the chat over it), `acp` or `sdk`. Settings → Agents sets it with a dropdown per agent; an agent left out has its default.

key.label: Key
key.desc: A chord that flips the focused agent tab between its terminal and the chat (the root key table). Empty for none; the title bar's button and the command work regardless.

history_mb.label: History read
history_mb.desc: How much of the end of a session file the chat reads when it opens. Older turns are left out of a bigger file.

bun.label: Bun
bun.desc: The Bun that runs each ACP or SDK chat tab's host process. Empty: the app's own.

permissions.label: Answer permissions in pumi
permissions.desc: Ask an agent's permission prompts in pumi (`request.open`), where the chat and any client can answer them; unanswered in two minutes, the agent asks in its own prompt. Claude Code's `PermissionRequest` hook.

restore.label: Restore recipes
restore.desc: How an agent resumes its session when its tab comes back, by agent id: the program and its arguments, with {session} for the session. Adds to or replaces the plugin's recipe for that agent; an empty list turns one off. The hook writes the line to the tab's `restore_command`.

context.label: Tell agents about the workspace
context.desc: A short guide to pumi and a map of the sessions, views, panes and tabs around the agent, at its start and with the prompts after. Off: agents are told nothing.

labels: At its start and when tabs change
context_updates.label: Updates
context_updates.desc: Keep agents up to date as tabs open, close and move, or tell them only when their session starts.

context_other_sessions.label: Other sessions
context_other_sessions.desc: The map has the tabs of your other sessions too, not only the agent's own.

commands.title: Agents: flip the focused tab between the terminal and the chat
Agents: continue this terminal agent in a chat tab (ACP or SDK)
Agents: continue this chat tab's session in the agent's terminal

traits.title: Agent
traits.desc: A tab whose agent has the plugin's hook: the agent's id (`claude`), set by the hook. `session` is its own session id, `model` its model, `transcript` its session file's absolute path, `accepts` what it takes besides typing (`["queue"]`: a queued prompt at its stop hook), and `conversation` the plugin that serves its conversation (`conversation.read`, `.send`, `.changed`).
